title: AGENTS.md — Development & Maintenance Guide
text: Git operations belong maintainer. Never run git commit, git push, git tag, history-modifying command. Prepare changes, suggest commands reply, let maintainer (Dai Shaoqing) execute . two legacy scripts never enter repository. glass_download_vi.R glass_process.R maintainer’s local reference scripts. gitignored must stay way: never git add -f , never copy content tracked files, never reference docs. private filesystem paths. Tracked files must never contain machine-specific paths F:/..., C:/Users/..., D:/Program    Files/... anything personal backup tree. examples tests use relative paths tempdir(). finishing task, grep files touched patterns. output/ local-. Paper drafts, journal outlines, software- copyright (软著) materials similar manuscripts live output/ (gitignored). Never track, commit, publish anything . Datasets build artifacts. data/glass_products.rda data/glass_tiles.rda regenerated scripts data-raw/. Never hand-edit data/*.rda; change build scripts re-run.

title: AGENTS.md — Development & Maintenance Guide
text: Full verification release: rebuild tarball run R CMD check (must stay 0 errors / 0 warnings). machine run R commands env -u LC_CTYPE -u LC_ALL -u LANG avoid Git Bash locale leak breaks child R processes.
code: # R executable used on this machine (Git Bash) R=/c/Rlanguage/R-4.6.1/bin/Rscript.exe  $R -e 'devtools::document()'        # regenerate man/ + NAMESPACE after roxygen edits $R -e 'devtools::test()'            # unit tests (add GLASS_SMOKE=1 for network tests) $R dev/smoke_test.R                 # offline smoke; GLASS_SMOKE=1 adds end-to-end download $R -e 'pkgdown::build_site()'       # rebuild docs/ (rerun after logo or doc changes)

title: AGENTS.md — Development & Maintenance Guide
text: Variants identified variant_id (e.g. LAI_MODIS_250M). verified = TRUE rows carry file-naming fragments (code, version, layer) band metadata (fill_value, scale_factor, valid_min/max) measured real granule; feed glass_read() automatically. Extending registry = extend data-raw/build_registry.R + rerun build chain, never edit .rda hand. terra/GDAL already apply HDF SDS scale/offset read; glass_read() converts raw fill value post-scale units NA-ing (see dev/README.md band-metadata notes).

title: 快速上手 glass.sqdaitools(中文)
text: GLASS 分幅产品沿用 MODIS 正弦投影的 h/v 网格。函数会重建精确的 瓦片多边形,告诉你研究区落在哪些瓦片上: 给定的直接是经纬度外接矩形时,用 glass_tiles_for_bbox(); 返回表(含 h/v 列)可以直接传给 glass_fetch()。

what: 日期区间 → 合成 DOY 文件夹
title: 快速上手 glass.sqdaitools(中文)
text: 归档按”合成起始日”的年积日(DOY)组织文件夹: 默认 mode = "span" 保留与日期区间有交集的所有合成; mode = "start" 只保留起始日落入区间内的合成——即旧脚本常用的语义。

title: 快速上手 glass.sqdaitools(中文)
text: glass_list_files() 读取单个合成文件夹的目录清单; glass_fetch() 按上一步的 DOY 表循环检索并下载(支持断点续传与校验): 下载引擎会与服务器比对文件大小,通过 HTTP Range 续传 .part 半截文件,并把 glass_manifest.csv 台账写进 out_dir, 中断后重跑会自动接着上次的进度。
code: files <- glass_fetch(   "LAI_MODIS_250M",   from = "2018-08-01", to = "2018-12-31",   roi = roi,   out_dir = "data/glass/lai" ) # 先看清单不下载:dry_run = TRUE

title: 快速上手 glass.sqdaitools(中文)
text: glass_process() 是参数化后的完整流水线:清理 → 镶嵌 → 重投影 → 掩膜 → 可选的时间维折叠: 波段清理规则来自登记表:原始填充值(如 255)按比例因子换算后置为 NA,有效范围之外的值同样剔除。若输入是已读入的 SpatRaster, glass_read() 只应用显式传入的 fill/valid_range 参数。
code: mean_lai <- glass_process(   files,   roi = roi,   product = "LAI_MODIS_250M",   method = "cubic",   fun = "mean",   outfile = "glass_lai_mean.tif" )

title: 快速上手 glass.sqdaitools(中文)

what: Tools for Downloading and Processing GLASS Land Surface Products
title: Tools for Downloading and Processing GLASS Land Surface Products
text: glass.sqdaitools toolkit whole GLASS data lifecycle: query products GLASS archive, map region interest onto h<h>v<v> sinusoidal tiling, expand date range composite DOY folders, batch-download resume + size verification, post-process granules terra (fill values, scaling, reprojection, multi-tile mosaics, temporal composites). 中文简介:glass.sqdaitools 是 GLASS(Global Land Surface Satellite)数据 全流程工具包:查询产品登记表、把研究区映射到正弦投影 h/v 瓦片、日期区间转 合成 DOY 文件夹、支持断点续传与大小校验的批量下载,以及基于 terra 的后处理 (填充值、比例因子、重投影、多瓦片镶嵌、时间合成)。中文快速上手: 《快速上手(中文)》。

what: GLASS sinusoidal tile lookup table — glass_tiles
title: GLASS sinusoidal tile lookup table — glass_tiles
text: global 36 x 18 ordered grid used tiled GLASS products (equivalent MODIS sinusoidal tile system). row holds WGS84 geographic bounding box one tile; tiles outside projection footprint carry NA bounds valid = FALSE. h horizontal tile index (0-35, west east) v vertical index (0-17, north south). Tiles referenced file names archive paths h<h>v<v>, e.g. h28v05. source table produced projecting bounding rectangles sinusoidal tiles (+proj=sinu sphere radius 6371007.181, tile width height 1111950.51966667 m) WGS84; see original glass_tiles.tsv data-raw/. Bounds curved tile polygons, strict bounding-box intersection test may slightly -select corner tiles. Use glass_tiles_for_bbox() glass_tiles_for_sf() exact selection.
